spec: drop1b: 10 new listings (3 beanies, 3 bucket hats, 3 quarter-zips, 1 golf shirt). Each design on each kind is its own listing, with the blanks as a Style option, like store/products/drop1.json.
status: Draft for the owner. Read-only: nothing changed in Shopify or Printful, nothing committed. Prices are placeholders the owner can change.
howToRead: listings[key].styles[] gives each Style's blank, sizes, price and this listing's design line (designFacts, which the copy may state). styles[details] holds that Style's price arithmetic, the facts the copy may state (mayState) and must not state (mustNotState), and what to check in Printful. A Style is the same blank in every listing of its kind. src ids are in sources.

method.currency: All prices in C$. US$ to C$ at 1.42, the rate store/apparel-plan.md uses (1 Oct 2026). Where Printful's own C$ price was seen, the higher of the two is used. Printful's C$ prices here run at 1.41 to 1.43 times its US$ prices, so 1.42 holds.
method.profit: Per item, as in store/apparel-plan.md: price, minus Printful's cost with embroidery, minus Shopify's card fee (Basic: 2.8% + 30c on a Canadian card, 3.5% + 30c on a US or Amex card). Before ads and one-time costs (digitizing US$6.50 per design file, samples). Each amount is rounded to the cent before subtracting, as the plan does.
method.floor: C$10 on a US card (the worse card) at the biggest size offered. None of the ten is a hoodie, so the C$15 hoodie floor doesn't apply; the quarter-zips clear C$15 anyway.
method.extraPlacement: +US$2.95 for each placement after the first (Printful). Only the golf shirt has two marks.
method.sizeMarkup: Printful adds about US$2.00 at 2XL and US$4.00 at 3XL (store/apparel-plan.md [12], marked CONFIRM there). The check uses the 3XL cost.
method.shipping: Store shipping today: Standard C$12, free from C$75 (store/picks.md). Under C$75 the buyer's C$12 covers Printful's US rate (hats from US$4.69, polos from US$4.95). From C$75 one item ships free, so the check also takes off Printful's US rate (polos US$4.95; quarter-zips the hoodie's US$8.79, their own rate not found). Printful's Canadian rates weren't found; the US rate stands in for them.
method.headroom: Where Printful's price with embroidery isn't confirmed, the price keeps at least US$2.95 (one placement fee) spare over the floor before shipping, so a listed price that turns out to leave out the embroidery still clears.
method.priceSteps: Prices use the store's endings: the lowest that passes these checks and sits sensibly on the live ladder (caps 34.99, tees 44.99, crewneck and sweatpants 79.99, hoodies 89.99, jacket 99.99). lowestPriceThatClears shows how low the cost alone would allow.
method.notInFloor: 13% HST on Printful's bill for an order made in Ontario and sent to Ontario while the store isn't registered (shown per Style as ifMadeInOntario); a 2% conversion fee if the US market is later priced in USD (it's in CAD today); duties; carts of several items that ship free.
method.sizes: Hats are one size (no Size option, like the caps). Clothes are capped at 3XL with no XS. No clothing size range was read on a Printful page (printful.com is blocked here), so each is marked likely, from copies of Printful's catalogue or several sources that agree. Check each in Printful's size picker, region Canada then US.

statusKey.confirmed: Printful's own page, as quoted in search results (rated so by the verified research)
statusKey.likely: Printful's text via a copy or one search read not re-checked, the maker's own spec, or several sources that agree

voice: Short, plain, sounds like a person wrote it, not too wordy. The owner likes 'your time'. Follow drop1.json: a hook, a time-off line, 'Made to order and shipped to you.', a short Details list.
neverWrite: 'Made in Canada', or where anything is made or embroidered (unknown for all nine blanks; AGENTS.md)

Blank brand names: adidas, Port Authority, SOL'S, Lane Seven, Cotton Heritage, Yupoong, Atlantis, Capstone, Big Accessories (AGENTS.md). A maker's logo on the garment is 'the shirt maker's own logo', as the jacket's listing does it

'premium', 'quality', 'perfect gift', 'must-have', stock counts, countdowns, reviews or ratings, made-up discounts or compare-at prices, exclamation marks, 'Off Shift', 'Offshift' (store/products/_template.md)

'heavyweight', 'organic', 'pre-shrunk', 'true to size' or any fabric or fit claim Printful's spec doesn't make. 'Organic' only for the Organic bucket hat, where Printful says it (store/apparel-copy.md)
'Embroidered' for the Premium quarter-zip until Printful confirms it
Thread colours (set after the sew-out) and colour names (chosen later)
Feel or performance words no source states: soft, warm, breathable, moisture-wicking, quick-dry, water-resistant, UPF, stretch, packable
Head sizes or garment measurements (no Printful size guide was read)
flags: Performance polo (A430): about twice the other polos' cost. C$89.99, the hoodie's price, is the lowest that clears C$10 in every size once one ships free: C$11.63 at 3XL, only US$1.14 to spare, so a higher price with embroidery would sink it. If Printful makes it in Ontario while the store isn't GST/HST-registered, an Ontario order makes C$8.94 (S to XL) to C$2.52 (3XL), under the floor. Owner: keep it, sell it S to 2XL only (C$14.47 at 2XL after shipping), register for GST/HST or charge shipping, or drop the style.

Premium quarter-zip (LS14014): Printful's embroidery on it isn't confirmed. If Printful's editor offers no left-chest embroidery, drop the style from all three quarter-zip listings; the Fleece stays. Its name 'Premium' is also on the template's never-write list ('Mock Neck' would be accurate).

Cotton Pique polo (SOL'S 11362): Large back isn't confirmed for Canada and the US, its size and gap to the collar are unknown, and it may be made only in Latvia (longer shipping, duties at the door). No Printful polo has a spot right below the collar. Fallbacks: the clock on its left sleeve; if it's EU-only, the research's stand-in is the Gildan 64800.

Ribbed beanie and Classic bucket hat sit at C$39.99 because their prices with embroidery aren't confirmed. Once confirmed, the Classic bucket hat can drop to C$34.99 (C$10.95 on a US card); the Ribbed beanie can't (C$9.68).
Organic bucket hat: Printful's own cost is C$29.50, so it needs C$44.99, the tee price. In Ontario without a GST/HST number it makes C$10.09, just over the floor.

The logo's clock-hand tips (0.58-0.59 mm) and 1.0 mm channel are under Printful's 1.27 mm line minimum: approve a sew-out on each new blank before selling. Samples cost money, so that's the owner's call.
Where Printful makes each of the nine blanks isn't known (Availability tab, region Canada then US). The copy never says where anything is made.
